name: Devour
doc: Devour (command ability; the act family, Pain's master): one emitter per action - the cast: one of three pictures and the title strip scrolling over the screen, the stage and the entities darkened (the devoured target hidden), the music faded, the outcome's sound; the master's release, the result. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag062_devour.cpp) run on the program's memory; its four pictures are loaded by the program's file loader.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its tasks the port's, its parts spawned by them): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: Drain's master in the act family's form: once its children are gone

pools.doc: the cast, the picture, the darkening, the music fade (the port's)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: the cast (its picture, darkening, music fade), the outcome's sound, the master's release, the result

parts.title: Picture
parts.doc: One of the three pictures and the title strip, scrolling, fading

parts.title: Darkening
parts.doc: The stage and the entities darkened, the devoured target hidden; the music faded

groups.label: Music
groups.doc: Its volume down from its tick by a step a tick, back up after its tick

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may start the next action at this tick

params.label: Result tick
params.doc: The result of its target from this tick

params.label: Outcome sound tick
params.doc: The outcome's sound (the exe's table by the result) at this tick of the cast

params.label: Scroll
params.doc: Pixels a tick to the left

params.label: Fade
params.doc: Brightness down a tick (0x80: all of it)

params.label: Step
params.doc: Back by this a tick (4096: all of it)

tasks.doc: One per action: the module's own emitter (the port's task): the cast task, the master's release, the result.
